g.text: The whole Sol's RNG Wiki in one app
Roll for Glorious, Transcendent and beyond
Every aura, biome, gear and cutscene
Works offline · new auras arrive by itself
Sols Wiki packs the whole Sol's RNG Wiki into one fast desktop app –
every aura, biome, gear, item, quest and cutscene, plus an Auto Roll to chase them
yourself. After the first start it works completely offline.
and crafting recipe for every aura
and the biome cycle – just like in-game
timers and the real tier colors
Live codes and badge stats, new
auras and updates arrive by themselves
Hit Auto Roll in the main menu and chase every
tier with real chances, luck boosts, breakthroughs,
Windows may show “Windows protected your PC” because the app is not
code-signed – click More info → Run anyway. It only happens once.
Q How do I uninstall it?
Settings → Uninstall removes the app, all
pictures and the settings in one click.
New auras and data arrive by themselves; a
new app version shows a notice with a button.
Q Does it touch the game?
No. Sols Wiki is its own program and never
interacts with Roblox or your account.
click a folder to open it
